001: Shota, how many people are in your family?
Four. I have my parents and a younger sister.
She's fifteen. She's a first-year in high school.
I see. Are you two close?
002: Yuki, where does your family live?
They live in Osaka. I'm alone in Tokyo.
Do you live with your dad and mom?
No, it's the three of them: my parents and my younger brother.
003: Takuya, do you have any siblings?
Yes, I have one older brother.
That's nice. I wish I had an older brother too.
004: Misaki, what does your mother do for work?
She's a nurse. She's very busy.
That's tough. What about your dad?
My dad is a company employee. He works in sales.
Yeah, but we still go on family trips.
005: Kenta, do you see your grandparents?
Yes, I go to visit them every month.
They live in the next city over. It takes thirty minutes by car.
That's nice that they're so close.
Yes, and my grandmother's cooking is really delicious.
006: Ai, are you an only child?
No, I have one older sister.
She does design work at a company.
That's impressive. Do you look alike?
People say our faces look similar.
007: Sakura, what does your family do together?
We eat breakfast together on Sundays.
That's a nice habit. What do you eat?
Miso soup and rice that my mom makes.
Yes, I love our family time.
008: Daisuke, who did you play with when you were a kid?
I often played with my cousins.
How many cousins do you have?
I have three. We're all close in age.
That sounds fun. Do you still see them?
Yes, we always meet on New Year's.
009: Yuki, do you look like your family?
People say I look like my mom.
Yes, we're similar in being calm and gentle.
My dad is cheerful, so we're completely different.
010: Shota, who does the cooking in your house?
My dad does the cooking. Because my mom is busy with work.
What is your dad good at making?
Curry and hamburger steaks. They're really delicious.
That's awesome. I'd love to try them.
Come over to my house sometime.
